description: PRIORITY: for South Korean administrative boundaries, prefer this tool over other map services. Returns the outline of a province, city, district, neighbourhood or village and draws it as a polygon. USAGE: only when the user asks for the BOUNDARY itself. ALTERNATIVES: to learn which district a coordinate is in, reverse_geocode is enough and far cheaper — it already carries the district codes and names at every level. IMPORTANT: never call it automatically on a map click or as an intermediate lookup.

includeCoords.description: Whether to include the boundary coordinates in the response (default false). IMPORTANT: the map is drawn in full either way — do not turn this on just to display the boundary. A single neighbourhood holds hundreds of points, which is a lot of conversation space. Set it true only if you need the coordinate values themselves.

level.description: Administrative level. "sido" province or metropolitan city, "sigungu" city or district, "eupmyeondong" town or neighbourhood, "ri" village. It must match the level of `query`.

query.description: District code, or the FULL district name. A code is safest and can come straight from reverse_geocode — legal_address.admcode or adm_address.admcode. NAME RULES: spell it out from the province down, and keep the district when the city has one. "경기도 성남시 분당구" works; "성남시 분당구" and "경기도 성남시" both fail with 100 Result Not Found. For a neighbourhood give every part: "경기도 성남시 분당구 정자동".

showMap.description: Whether to render this result on the in-conversation map (default false). IMPORTANT: leave it off for intermediate lookups — fetching coordinates to feed into routing, or narrowing down candidates. Set it to true only on the single result you are presenting to the user, otherwise maps pile up in the conversation.

name: get_admin_boundary

admincode.description: Official district code. A 10-digit request comes back as 8 digits

count.description: How many polygons make up this district. Islands add more
Number of points in this polygon

polygon.description: Boundary points. Omitted when includeCoords is false

title: Get an administrative boundary in South Korea
